name: East Bay Bridge
summary: East Bay Bridge is a renovated 32-acre retail park in Emeryville featuring household-name department stores and national retailers, serving the East Bay community since 1994. The open-air center offers convenient parking and accessible shopping with operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily.
demographics: East Bay Bridge attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle income demographic from the Emeryville and greater East Bay area, including young professionals, families, and urban residents from nearby Oakland and Berkeley. The trade area serves a well-educated population with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, drawn by the center's convenient location near major transportation corridors and mix of household-name retailers. Shoppers typically seek one-stop convenience shopping for home goods, apparel, and everyday needs, with strong weekday traffic from the surrounding business district and weekend family visits.
description: East Bay Bridge is a renovated 32-acre retail park located in Emeryville, California, that has been serving the East Bay community since 1994. Strategically positioned at 3838 Hollis Street, this open-air shopping destination offers convenient access with ample parking and features household-name department stores and national retailers. The center underwent significant renovations to modernize its facilities and enhance the shopping experience for its diverse customer base. As part of Federal Realty Investment Trust's portfolio, East Bay Bridge benefits from professional management and a commitment to maintaining a high-quality retail environment. The center's location in Emeryville places it at the crossroads of Oakland, Berkeley, and San Francisco, making it an accessible shopping destination for residents throughout the East Bay region. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the center accommodates both weekday convenience shopping and leisurely weekend visits. The property has earned a strong 4.2-star rating from nearly 4,000 Google reviews, reflecting its popularity and consistent service to the community.
